segments.name: Chemicals
segments.description: Through majority-controlled Kronos, produces and markets value-added titanium dioxide pigments to customers in coatings, plastics, paper and specialty applications worldwide.
segments.evidence: Our Chemicals Segment is operated through our majority control of Kronos. Kronos is a leading global producer and marketer of value-added titanium dioxide pigments.

segments.name: Component Products
segments.description: Through majority-controlled CompX, manufactures security products for furniture, cabinetry, postal and healthcare uses, plus marine wake enhancement and related accessories.
segments.evidence: CompX is a leading manufacturer of security products used in the postal, recreational transportation, office and institutional furniture, cabinetry, tool storage, healthcare applications and a variety of other industries.

segments.name: Real Estate Management and Development
segments.description: Through majority-controlled BMI and LandWell, owns and develops real property in Henderson, Nevada for commercial, industrial and residential purposes.
segments.evidence: LandWell is engaged in efforts to develop certain land holdings for commercial, industrial and residential purposes in Henderson, Nevada.
